case.summary: This internal fraud case summary concludes that account takeover fraud occurred on card C08623-K2, resulting in a total exposure of $165.93. Key evidence includes the cardholder's repeated confirmation that they did not make the disputed $49.00 purchase while retaining physical possession of the card, alongside eight out of eight similar closed cases confirmed as fraud. The verdict is fraud. The automated action executed is CREATE_CASE, and the pending human approval action is BLOCK_CARD (L1).
